pages.title: Omniscience Catalyst
pages.text: Physics, mathematics, the stars, time, mind and exotic matter, every singularity of knowledge fused into one catalyst. Holding it, for an instant you understand everything that is the case. Then the knowledge fades, leaving a sense of having forgotten something enormous.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)On the Extreme Assembly Table, I combined the Theory of Everything with every other conceptual singularity I had compressed. They fused into a catalyst that let me glimpse everything for a moment.
